g.text: M2: pool-layout control and within-pool cap intervention
JCT interaction: D(B) - D(C) = +0.612s, +0.781s. D = Mixed minus Separate.
Both mean JCTs increase at C: the smaller gap is not a speedup. Only two independent starts.
B/C share the physical pool within each mode/start. A/B also change auxiliary memory and server session.
Exploratory cap interaction only; no hybrid exclusivity, equal-total-HBM benefit, or new-algorithm claim.
